# FDG7042

> DO throw `ArgumentException` or one of its subtypes if bad arguments are passed to a member. Prefer the most derived exception type, if applicable.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.3.4 ArgumentException, ArgumentNullException, and ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: whether an argument is bad is judgment. Null arguments of public members are FDG5108 (CA1062).
